title: Core: Motion tween rotation interpolation
description: Verify and test motion tween rotation (motionRotate: auto/cw/ccw) in packages/core/src/model/timeline-query.ts. For 'auto': compute shortest rotation path between start and end angles. For 'cw'/'ccw': always rotate in the specified direction, adding motionRotateCount full rotations. Tests: auto picks shortest, cw/ccw respect direction, motionRotateCount adds extra spins.
